description: This file is a Makefile fragment for building and packaging OpenWrt packages, including functions for dependency management, package creation, and installation scripts.

methods.name: gen_package_wildcard
methods.description: Generates a wildcard pattern for package files based on package name and ABI version filtering.

methods.name: remove_ipkg_files
methods.description: Removes specified ipkg or apk package files for a given package.

methods.name: BuildPackVariable
methods.description: Defines package build variables and commands based on package name, variable name, suffix, and script flag.

methods.name: dep_split
methods.description: Splits dependency strings by colon into list.

methods.name: dep_rem
methods.description: Removes parentheses and negation from dependency strings.

methods.name: dep_and
methods.description: Evaluates logical AND of configuration conditions.

methods.name: dep_confvar
methods.description: Constructs configuration variable expressions based on dependencies.

methods.name: dep_if
methods.description: Determines dependency condition based on negation.

methods.name: AddDependency
methods.description: Adds dependencies to package dependency list.

methods.name: FixupReverseDependencies
methods.description: Fixes reverse dependencies for a package.

methods.name: CheckDependencies
methods.description: Checks for missing dependencies of a package.
